comments.message: OUT! Caught. Marco Jansen to Jasprit Bumrah. Off cutter half volley, middle stump on the front foot driving, mis-timed in the air uncontrolled to cover, caught by Markram. South Africa wrap up the contest and take a commanding 76-run victory. India's batting lineup faltered, as the top order collapsed and the middle order failed to find momentum. Shivam Dube offered some resistance, top-scoring with 42 runs, but it wasn't enough to turn the tide. For South Africa, Marco Jansen led the charge with four wickets, while Keshav Maharaj produced a remarkable spell, claiming three wickets in a single over. David Miller's impactful innings earned him the Player of the Match award.
